identityReview: Ulf Michael Widenius, known as Monty, Finnish MySQL cofounder and MariaDB company CTO, matched across company and foundation biographies. Birth year 1962 uses Wikipedia identity section. Not Anna Widenius, foundation CEO, or Kaj Arno, executive chairman.
lifeStatusEvidence: VSHN October 28, 2026 retrospective describes his personal talk at the October 19 Zurich technical roadshow. Host report supports recent activity; June 24 minutes list him absent and are not attendance evidence.

sourceReview.accessMethod: Full sections read through web tools as documented in checkpoint; no search-only snippets treated as verified body content.
sourceReview.scope: Identity, company and foundation roles, education limits, database contributions, project/release chronology, foundation announcement and recent event.
corrections: Birth year and Finnish identity follow secondary Wikipedia source; degree not inferred from having studied at Helsinki University of Technology.
MySQL and MariaDB development are team achievements. No claim that Widenius invented relational databases or independently created all features.

Company CTO differs from foundation ex-officio founder director. Anna Widenius is foundation CEO; Kaj Arno executive chairman. Foundation page also lists Monty in its technical team, but current profile emphasizes verified company CTO and foundation board roles.
June 24, 2026 foundation minutes place him among absent board members. Timeline records board-status evidence, not attendance.
VSHN recap published October 28 concerns October 19, 2026 event. Host is a commercial partner; promotional benchmarks are omitted.

October 30, 2024 signed MariaDB retrospective dates project start April 20, 2009 and first version 5.1.38 October 29, 2009. First release is not labeled stable GA. Project start is attributed to his retrospective.
April 20, 2009 was Oracle announcement of plans to acquire Sun, not completion. February 26, 2008 Sun acquisition of MySQL AB differs from January 16 announcement.

Sun transaction chronology is supported by Ronald Bradford 2010 briefing hosted on Oracle, whose disclaimer says views are his own. Do not represent this as an Oracle corporate press release. Company biography independently supports sale to Sun in 2008.

Early MySQL dates differ between Wikipedia and historical briefing; exact founding/first-release dates omitted pending stronger original evidence. Unread MySQL anniversary poster is not counted as a source.

December 4, 2012 formation announcement names Widenius, David Axmark and Allan Larsson and interim CTO role; planned February 2013 board elections and US tax-status application are not completed events.
Company and foundation biographies support 2003 Finnish Software Entrepreneur of the Year award. Technical manual coauthorship is supported without adding an unverified publication date.
sourceReview.limits: AI-authored and AI-reviewed; not human or native-language certification. Secondary birth source, author-attributed project retrospective and third-party hosted historical briefing are identified. No universal migration compatibility or performance claims.
